page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, with a running head above it and a gathering signature at the foot right. Headings are set in italic and in capitals. A decorative rule separates the end of the Architecture section from "DE ETHICA." Page number at the head right.

main_text.p: Horti & piscinæ, garten vnd fischteiche. Horti pensiles sunt, qui de fenestris appenduntur. Hortos circundant sepes structiles, vel vivæ seu naturales ex rubis & spinis.
Machina, ein rüstzeug / est pars Architecturæ subveniens desperatis actionibus, qua etiam contra naturam agere licet.

Cùm onera machinis trahuntur, aut ad altitudinem sublata deponuntur: Cujus species fere sunt: Fistuca, ein schlegel/ so man auff zeucht vnd laßt wieder herab fallen / daß die pfäle in den boden gehen/ Trochlea, ein welle vber die ein seil oder kette gehet an einem zug / Tympanum, ein zugrad/ ein kranich/ Succula, ein zugwahl/ die man mit stangen vmbtreibet / Vectis, ein stang.
Lecturus præcepta prolixiora videat Vitruvium, Grapaldum & alios.
Hactenus expofita est Architectura: sequi-tur Ethica.
main_text.head: DE ETHICA.
main_text.p: ETHICA, die tugentkunst / est ars secundum virtutem vivendi: Cujus Subjectum est Virtus.
Est habitus animi in mediocritate consistens. Cu-jus species sunt quatuor: Justitia, Fortitudo, Pruden-tia, Temperantia.

page.notes: Black letter (German) words are marked with bl. Doubtful: the printed "expofita" (for exposita) is kept as printed, a probable printing error. "fi!chteiche" in the first paragraph is read as "fischteiche". The "ein rüstzeug" and "tugentkunst" lines are read from a small scan and may contain minor errors. The drop cap E of "Ethica" is joined to the word. The decorative rule above DE ETHICA is not text.
